title: Quiz: HTML Emails and Newsletters
description: Check your understanding of HTML Emails and Newsletters.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in HTML?
questions.explanation: In HTML, <!-- --> marks a comment. Block comments use -->.

questions.question: Why do HTML emails use table layouts?
options: Email clients have poor CSS support — tables render reliably
questions.correctAnswer: Email clients have poor CSS support — tables render reliably
questions.explanation: Outlook-era rendering engines only handle tables well.

questions.question: True or False: You can rely on <style> blocks and flexbox in HTML emails.
questions.explanation: This statement is incorrect — review the lesson.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: use ${css} styles in emails — clients strip <style>
In HTML, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
